name: Logic analyzer, 8 channels (Saleae Logic 8)
description: Saleae's Logic 8 USB logic analyzer: eight channel leads and ground, each input 1 MOhm in parallel with 10 pF, high above 1.2 V and low below 0.6 V. It samples the eight inputs at its chosen rate (1 to 100 MS/s; 100 MS/s on up to 3 channels, 25 MS/s on all 8), from Start for a set duration or around a trigger on one channel's edge, and streams the capture to the workbench, where it is read as Saleae's Logic 2 software shows it: channel rows, protocol decoders, measurements.

functional.claims: Samples the eight inputs at the chosen rate exactly as a sampler does (an edge at the first sample instant after it, a change undone before the next sample instant missed), the rate limited by the channels on as the data sheet gives it, a capture from Start for its duration or around a trigger on one channel's edge with a pre-trigger share, read live by instrument.read.

sources.title: Saleae Logic 8 data sheet (DOC_620-00011_V20260521): input impedance 1 MOhm || 10 pF; digital threshold VIL +0.6 V, VIH +1.2 V; digital sample rates 100, 50, 40, 25, 20, 10, 8, 5, 4, 2, 1 MSPS, footnote 1: 100 MSPS on up to 3 channels, 50 MSPS on up to 6, 40 MSPS on up to 7 (8 channels, digital only, 25 MSPS); 25 MHz digital bandwidth; -25 V to +25 V absolute maximum, 0 V to +5 V recommended
Saleae support, supported voltages: the Logic 8's digital threshold is fixed, input low 0.6 V, input high 1.2 V
sources.notes: The data sheet labels the threshold 'Selectable' but gives one pair of levels; this page says the Logic 8's threshold is fixed, as modelled.
